comment: Eras and turn length (GDD 6.2). monthsPerTurn: 600 = 50 years. Every rate in the game is defined per year and converted with this value. threshold (optional, stage 3f): the technology that opens the era, together with eraSharePercent of the previous era's technologies (technologies.json). armyLimit and troopsPerCell (stage 4e PR 3, GDD 9.3): most warriors one leader leads in a campaign, and most warriors on one cell (a bigger army stands on several cells next to each other, a front). Eras 1-2: 50 and 50 (one cell); later eras keep these until their own stage updates the war module (docs/systems/war.md, Every era).
